evidence: Archived news evidence leading into the target window highlights meaningful corporate selling pressure. MARA Holdings sold 13,597 BTC to retire debt and Hyperscale Data liquidated its remaining 211.56 BTC reserves, creating headline supply overhang. These outflows notably outweigh minor treasury accumulation (Strive adding 29 BTC). Long-term announcements such as a 2028 conference and routine Arkham ETP labeling updates provide negligible short-term price support. On balance, net corporate sell-side flows tilt the 24-hour directional bias downward.
limitations: Archived articles reflect company treasury actions rather than spot order book liquidity or macroeconomic data.
News regarding a 2028 conference was excluded as non-direct long-term narrative.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
